# Tocas UI 5.7.0

Vendored from https://github.com/teacat/tocas at tag `5.7.0`, commit
`3d4f2d86d9c6231e5eac978f56124c906188f419`.

Only the minified CSS, JavaScript and icon fonts used by this application are
included. Flag images are not needed. Tocas UI uses the MIT License (`LICENSE`).
Font Awesome Free bundled icon fonts use SIL OFL 1.1:
https://fontawesome.com/license/free (full text in `FONT-AWESOME-LICENSE.txt`).
The bundled fonts identify themselves as Font Awesome 6.7.2; its CSS/code uses MIT.

The Tocas JavaScript includes Floating UI (upstream source labels it 1.2.2);
its MIT notice is retained in `FLOATING-UI-LICENSE.txt`. The Tocas stylesheet
includes flag-icons styles, with the MIT notice in `FLAG-ICONS-LICENSE.txt`.
Flag SVG images are not distributed. See `../../docs/LICENSING.md` for the audit.

The interface loads these retained files locally and does not require a CDN.
